_comment: DefaultConnection and Jwt:Key must be supplied via environment variables (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Jwt__Key) or a secrets manager at deploy time - do not hardcode real credentials in this checked-in file. The previous value here pointed at an unrelated server/database (E-ProgramDBAPP\MSSQLSERVER2019 / EProgramIntegration_DB) with a live plaintext password and did not match this project - verify the real production target before deploying.
